BA: Hey, good to finally get this on the calendar. How has your week been?

Client: Pretty good, thanks. A bit hectic with the weather here, we had some flooding on the main road into the office so half the team worked from home yesterday.

BA: Oh no, is everything okay?

Client: Yeah, nothing too serious, just a lot of detours and a soggy car park. It cleared up by the evening.

BA: Glad to hear it. I was actually at a conference in Lisbon last week, that is partly why we pushed this call back a few days.

Client: Oh nice, how was it?

BA: Really good actually, though the flights were a mess. Got delayed on the way out and then again on the way back, so I basically lost a whole day to airports.

Client: Classic. I had the same thing happen to me in the spring, ended up stuck in an airport for six hours with nothing to do.

BA: The worst. Did you at least get some good coffee out of it?

Client: Ha, barely, everything was closed by the time I got through security. Anyway, are we still good for the follow up call next Thursday, or did that need to move?

BA: Thursday should still work on my end, let me just double check with the rest of the team and I will confirm by email tomorrow.

Client: Sounds good. If Thursday does not work, I am pretty flexible the week after as well, just let me know.

BA: How is the rest of the team doing generally, everyone recovered from the busy season?

Client: Mostly, yeah. It has been a long few months but things are finally calming down a little, which is nice.

BA: Good to hear. Alright, I will let you get back to your day, thanks for the chat.

Client: No problem, talk soon.
